lifeisbitter.tip.title: Life is bitter
lifeisbitter.tip.urine: You can get urine by 'milking' pig
lifeisbitter.tip.iron: Iron is weak, use steel for equipment instead!
lifeisbitter.tip.radegast_1: Alah is powerfull god, but even he can't beat Radegast.
lifeisbitter.tip.steel_1: You can get steel by mixing charcoal and iron in basin!
lifeisbitter.tip.firework_1: Fireworks now need cardboard instead of paper.
lifeisbitter.tip.firework_2: Fireworks without star need solid fuel instead of gunpowder.
lifeisbitter.tip.copper_burner: Copper burner is cheaper than blaze burner, but is half as efficient and can't super burn.
